findings.title: DMARC not enforced (p=none): domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud

evidence.excerpt: DMARC record: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@brightwaterfleet.example; policy=none, pct=100, rua=true.

findings.deal_impact: Domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud, increasing payment-fraud and phishing risk and potentially affecting cyber-insurance diligence; remediation is low-complexity but requires staged enforcement.

remediation.summary: Move DMARC from p=none to quarantine then reject, monitor rua reports, and align SPF/DKIM for all senders.

findings.title: SPF uses soft/neutral fail

evidence.excerpt: SPF record: v=spf1 include:_spf.mailhost.example include:sendgrid.example ~all; qualifier=~all, lookup_count=2.

findings.deal_impact: Soft-fail SPF weakens sender authentication and complements the DMARC non-enforcement spoofing risk for transaction-related phishing.

remediation.summary: Inventory authorized senders, then change SPF ~all to -all once legitimate sources are confirmed.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled

evidence.excerpt: DNSSEC check for brightwaterfleet.example DS record: enabled=false.

findings.deal_impact: Unsigned DNS increases spoofing/cache-poisoning risk for web and email traffic; usually a straightforward registrar/DNS change with limited deal impact.

remediation.summary: Enable DNSSEC at the DNS provider/registrar, publish DS records, and monitor validation.

findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: Risky hostname vpn.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern=vpn, first_seen=2023-02-11, last_seen=2026-09-30.
Risky hostname jenkins-old.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern=jenkins|old, first_seen=2021-06-03, last_seen=2026-08-14.
Risky hostname staging-api.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern=staging, first_seen=2024-01-20, last_seen=2026-10-01.
Risky hostname legacy-portal.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern=legacy, first_seen=2019-11-05, last_seen=2026-07-22; risky_hostnames_count=4.

findings.deal_impact: Publicly visible VPN, old Jenkins, staging, and legacy names expand attack surface and suggest asset-inventory/decommissioning diligence is needed before closing.

remediation.summary: Validate ownership and exposure of each risky hostname, decommission or restrict legacy/staging/admin systems, and enforce MFA/patching on VPN.

findings.title: Large certificate footprint relative to company size

evidence.excerpt: Certificate Transparency query found unique_hostnames=47 for brightwaterfleet.example (employee band 201-1000).

findings.deal_impact: A 47-hostname certificate footprint for a 201-1000 employee company suggests inventory sprawl and possible forgotten assets to confirm in diligence.

remediation.summary: Reconcile CT hostnames against CMDB/asset inventory, assign owners, and remove or retire unowned certificates/hosts.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS versions offered

evidence.excerpt: Host www.brightwaterfleet.example tls_support: TLSv1.0=true, TLSv1.1=true, TLSv1.2=true, TLSv1.3=not_tested; tls_versions=[TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2].

findings.deal_impact: Deprecated TLS on www weakens transport security and may indicate legacy web/VPN configuration diverging from the apex host, requiring remediation in value-creation planning.

remediation.summary: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 on www/web front ends, retain TLSv1.2+, and rescan all hosts for consistency.

findings.title: HSTS not set
findings.deal_impact: Missing HSTS allows protocol-downgrade risk on first visits; low deal impact as header deployment is quick once HTTPS coverage is confirmed.

remediation.summary: Add Strict-Transport-Security header with an appropriate max-age on apex and www after confirming full HTTPS support.

findings.title: Internet-facing appliance listed in CISA KEV (version not verified)

evidence.excerpt: KEV match CVE-PLACEHOLDER-0001, vendor=ExampleGate, product=ExampleGate SSL-VPN, version=7.0.11, match_tier=appliance_exposed, match_level=product; note: KEV lists products, not affected versions; version not verified. Fingerprint also in check_web_posture via single_https_get.

findings.deal_impact: Potential exposure to a known-exploited internet-facing VPN appliance warrants urgent pre-close verification of patch level and compensating controls; version not verified, so severity reflects potential exposure, not confirmed exploitability.

remediation.summary: Immediately verify ExampleGate SSL-VPN version/patch against the KEV entry, patch or isolate the appliance, and review VPN logs for compromise.

findings.title: Publicly disclosed security incident in the last 24 months

evidence.excerpt: State AG breach notice dated 2025-08-14: unauthorized access to a customer support system; approx. 3,100 individuals notified; entity_match=exact; disclosed_within_months=14.

findings.deal_impact: A breach disclosed 14 months ago with ~3,100 notified individuals raises regulatory, customer-trust, remediation-proof, and insurability questions requiring incident-response diligence.

remediation.summary: Obtain incident report, regulator correspondence, remediation evidence, and lessons-learned actions; verify closure and monitoring improvements.
